answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The sparrow holds work receipts rather than names, so the onyx of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. What survives to the opal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
